description:
About us
  
  
Bain & Company is a global management consulting firm that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
  
  
In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
  
  
Who you will work with
  
  
Corporate Finance teams are part of ‘Corporate Strategy and Finance solution (CS&F)’. CS&F works as an innovation partner for Bain’s Global strategy practice to enable cutting-edge Intellectual property (IP) / Point of view (PoV) development & commercialization and flawless client delivery. Our strength lies in our people who are experts across different aspects of the strategy topic vis-a-vis business and corporate strategy, CEO and leadership ways of working and corporate finance, backed by solid capabilities around research, analytics, and stakeholder management.
  
  
Corporate Finance team works with Bain teams across the globe with solutions to corporate finance and capital markets related aspects. We have a wide array of highly customizable offerings and tailored analyses to address key CXO concerns. Focus is on equipping the C-Suite with the right tools to shape their agenda on long-term shareholder value creation. The team conducts financial diagnostics for client companies, codifies Bain’s intellectual property and contributes to new intellectual property.
  
  
Alongside this core diagnostic, modelling and valuation work, we build and run a growing set of proprietary AI-enabled tools that change how quickly Bain can analyse a company and shape a value creation agenda. Operating across Gurugram and Mexico City, we work with case teams across geographies and industries; however, we focus almost exclusively on Corporate Finance domain-related projects geared towards Capital Markets. Managers here get both: rigorous corporate finance delivery, and a front-row seat on the tooling that is reshaping how it gets done
  
  
About you
  

* Graduate or postgraduate with a specialisation in finance and a strong academic record. CFA (Level 1 passed or above) and or CA preferred; CA candidates should have meaningful exposure to capital markets or valuation. Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint assumed
* 8-11 years of relevant experience in investment banking, equity research, or consulting with corporate finance exposure (6-9 years if your highest qualification is postgraduate)
* Strong command of financial statement analysis, ratio analysis, and underlying valuation principles. You can trace how a change in one financial metric flows through the statements and into valuation, and read financial data for what it means: why growth, margins, returns, multiples or leverage look the way they do, and the competitive dynamics sitting behind them
* Should have created financial models from scratch rather than updating set templates, with the focus on strategic choices and their impact on valuation rather than valuation mechanics alone
* Strong inclination towards Capital Markets, and abreast of the prevailing economic environment, stock markets and capital flows
* Able to cross-link business models and industry dynamics, using the key drivers and KPIs behind operational and financial performance to generate a compelling equity story with a focus on the ‘so what’
* Fluency with AI tools is strongly preferred and will differentiate candidates. We are looking for someone who already works this way rather than someone who intends to start. Be ready to point to specifics: an analysis or deliverable you materially accelerated using tools such as Claude or ChatGPT, a prompt or workflow you designed and handed to colleagues, or a manual process you removed
* A technical mindset is a genuine advantage. Exposure to Python, financial data APIs, or building lightweight tools all count. You do not need to be an engineer. You do need to be curious about how things are built and willing to get into the mechanics yourself rather than delegating them
* Structured thinker with sound business logic and thought leadership, able to frame an approach to a complex, ambiguous question and stand behind the answer
* Articulate and compelling in oral and written communication skills; engaging and concise with interpersonal "presence"; adaptable across executive, technical, and Bain audiences
* Prior experience managing and leading teams: allocating and reviewing work, coaching and mentoring, conducting performance discussions, and writing appraisal reviews
* Entrepreneurial, proactive and productive; instinctively sees what needs to be done, rallies colleagues, rolls up the sleeves and gets it done

What you’ll do
  
  

* Direct the team on corporate finance and capital markets projects and case delivery, owning close relationships with Partners, Bain case teams, and practice areas
* Working with the CoE Director, lead 2 teams of Project Leads, Associates and Analysts to produce client-ready research and insights, and drive the team’s overall answer, final materials, client communication, and work planning. Teams conduct financial diagnostics for client companies, codify Bain’s intellectual property, and contribute to new IP
* Own quality end to end: select the right analytical approach for the question, pressure-test the logic, and hold an error-free bar across every workstream
* Manage senior Bain stakeholders and set the right expectations, pushing past the brief to the ‘so what’ and to what more the team could be doing
* Use and champion AI in day-to-day delivery. Apply tools such as Claude and ChatGPT along with proprietary CF AI tools to accelerate research, analysis and drafting; help the team adopt them well and safely; and feed real delivery experience into the AI tools the CoE builds
* Own staffing and workload across your teams, assigning specific workstreams and managing capacity appropriately
* Coach and develop the team: give meaningful, actionable feedback in every interaction, run performance discussions, write appraisals, and build people towards leadership roles on BCN teams
* Act as a business owner: grow the CF footprint, add new offerings and IP under the CF umbrella, and build the case for them with practice stakeholders
* Contribute to the wider BCN agenda through recruiting (on-campus, industry and other channels), training, resource planning, and business strategy initiatives

What makes us a great place to work
  
  
We are proud to be [1] consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for [2] diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

Change, Release and Continuous Improvement

* Translate finance and regulatory requirements into clear solution options, functional specifications, acceptance criteria and test scenarios.
* Assess proposed changes for cross-module, integration, reporting, data and control impacts before approval.
* Partner with technical teams and vendors on configuration, integrations and extensions, ensuring solutions follow D365 standard capability wherever practical.
* Support release planning, regression testing, deployment readiness, post-release validation and benefits realisation.

Data, Integrations and Reporting

* Protect the integrity of finance master data, dimensions, opening balances, sub-ledger data and intercompany processing.
* Support D365 integrations including banking, payments, expense, tax, consolidation and downstream reporting platforms.
* Partner with Data and Reporting teams on D365 financial reporting, Power BI and Workiva outputs, ensuring consistent definitions and reconciliation to the ledger.

Controls, Audit and Governance

* Embed segregation of duties, access controls, change evidence, configuration governance and audit-ready documentation into day-to-day platform ownership.
* Support ITGC and financial-controls evidence, remediation activity and audit requests relating to D365.
* Operate within the Finance Systems governance framework, including demand intake, design authority, environment management, release control and capacity planning.

Future Roadmap and Team Leadership

* Provide functional leadership for future D365 capabilities such as Consolidation, advanced Treasury and Cash Management, Project Accounting and other agreed modules.
* Support future entity onboarding, acquisitions and migrations from legacy finance platforms into D365.
* Help shape the D365 roadmap and operating model, reducing avoidable external dependency and building a sustainable internal capability.
* Lead the D365 pillar through influence and subject-matter authority; line-management responsibilities may be added as the team develops.

Essential

* 10+ years of hands-on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations / Dynamics AX functional experience, including significant responsibility for finance modules.
* Demonstrable experience delivering and supporting complex, multi-entity and multi-currency D365 implementations.
* Deep understanding of Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash processes, with strong knowledge of financial controls and close activities.

* Ability to diagnose complex functional issues, evaluate trade-offs and drive decisions through to resolution.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the credibility to work with senior Finance stakeholders, regional teams, auditors and external partners.
* Ability to work independently in a global environment while maintaining disciplined documentation, governance and knowledge sharing.

Preferred

* Experience with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Workiva, Azure DevOps and finance-data integrations.
* Previous experience as a solution architect, functional lead, platform owner or capability lead.

5. Success Measures

* Stable and controlled D365 operations through month-end, year-end and business-critical processing.
* Clear ownership and timely resolution of functional incidents, problems and enhancement requests.
* High-quality functional designs, test evidence, release documentation and audit artefacts.
* Reduced reliance on external partners for routine functional decisions and platform knowledge.
* A prioritised improvement roadmap aligned to Finance outcomes, risk and available capacity.

**Location:** Delhi / Gurugram


**Type:** Full\-time


**Experience:** 3–8 years


**Industry Preference:** NBFC / MSME Lending / SME Lending / Financial Services


**Role Overview**
-----------------


We are looking for a Senior Relationship Manager with strong experience in NBFC/MSME lending or investment sales, along with the ability to understand and analyze financial statements.


The candidate will be responsible for sourcing and developing relationships with MSME/SME businesses, identifying lending and investment opportunities, understanding business requirements, conducting preliminary financial analysis, and managing the relationship through the transaction lifecycle.


### **Key Responsibilities**


#### **1\. Business Development \& Sales**


* Source new MSME/SME lending and investment opportunities through direct sourcing, referrals, CA networks, DSAs, financial advisors, and industry contacts.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with SME/MSME promoters, business owners, and CXOs.
* Identify businesses that meet the lending/investment requirements of the assigned business or entity.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective clients and opportunities.
* Achieve assigned business development, sourcing, and revenue targets.

#### **2\. Relationship Management**


* Manage relationships with existing and prospective MSME/SME clients.
* Understand the client's business model, financial requirements, funding needs, and growth plans.
* Act as the primary point of contact and ensure smooth coordination throughout the transaction process.
* Develop long\-term relationships with promoters, referral partners, and other stakeholders.

#### **3\. Financial Analysis \& Initial Assessment**


* Analyze P\&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow statements of prospective businesses.
* Understand profitability, leverage, liquidity, working capital, and cash\-flow position.
* Conduct preliminary assessment of the company's financial strength and repayment/investment capacity.
* Review financial information and identify key business and financial risks.
* Coordinate with the Credit/Risk/Investment teams for detailed evaluation and underwriting.

#### **4\. Deal Execution \& Coordination**


* Coordinate with internal teams including Credit, Risk, Finance, Legal, Operations, and Compliance.
* Support the transaction process from sourcing and initial evaluation through sanction/investment and disbursement, wherever applicable.
* Ensure timely collection of financial and business documents from clients.
* Support structuring of suitable lending/investment solutions based on business requirements.

#### **5\. Portfolio \& Relationship Monitoring**


* Maintain regular engagement with clients and monitor business performance.
* Track repayment/business performance and identify potential concerns or early warning signals.
* Support repeat business and cross\-selling opportunities.
* Maintain accurate records and MIS of business sourced and relationships managed.

### **Ideal Candidate**


* 3–8 years of relevant experience in NBFC, MSME/SME lending, business banking, or financial services.
* Strong experience in MSME lending or investment sales.
* Existing network among MSME/SME promoters, CAs, DSAs, financial advisors, and business networks will be an advantage.
* Ability to understand and analyze financial statements and business performance.
* Good understanding of credit, lending, and financial products.
* Strong relationship management, communication, negotiation, and sales skills.
* Ability to balance business development with financial/business assessment.
* MBA Finance / CA / CFA or equivalent qualification will be an advantage.
### **Not Suitable**


* Pure retail loan sales profiles.
* Candidates with only retail lending experience.
* Pure sales profiles without understanding of financial statements.
* Freshers or candidates without relevant NBFC/SME/MSME experience.
### **What We Offer**


* Opportunity to work with a growing financial services group.
* Exposure to MSME lending, investments, and multiple businesses within the Company.
* Direct interaction with business owners and senior management.
* Growth\-oriented role with business development and financial analysis exposure.
* Competitive compensation and performance\-based incentives.

The selected candidate may be aligned with any specific business, vertical, subsidiary, associate, or entity within the Company based on organizational requirements.


The candidate may also be employed on the payroll of Company. or any other entity within the Company, as determined by management and business requirements.

Required

* Strong Excel skills and experience working with large data sets across multiple entities.
* Proven ability to manage multiple deadlines in a complex, global environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex tax topics to non‑tax stakeholders.

Preferred

* Process orientated and continuous improvement mindset.
* Effective stakeholder and auditor management.
* Ability to balance detail with management perspective.
* High ownership, resilience, and problem‑solving ability in fast‑paced environments.

We're looking for someone to own the financial strategy and capital planning function of the organization, effectively acting as the finance partner to the founder/CEO, across our consulting \& research division and our communications division (potentially extending to affiliated entities or sister ventures). Qualifications

**8\+ years in progressively senior finance roles, with at least 2\-3 years owning financial strategy, forecasting, or capital decisions, not just accounting execution**  Strong grounding in financial modeling, scenario planning, unit economics, and cash flow forecasting for a project/consulting\-revenue business **Experience managing statutory compliance, audits, and regulatory relationships (GST, TDS, EPF, ESI, income tax, ROC/company law basics)**  Working knowledge of contracts, MoUs, and commercial terms, able to review and negotiate, not just file **Demonstrated experience building or scaling a finance function: designing the systems, not just running them**  CA / MBA (Finance) strongly preferred; CFA or equivalent a plus **Prior exposure to consulting, government/development\-sector, or multi\-vertical service businesses is a strong plus**  Comfortable operating with founder\-level ambiguity; priorities will shift, and you're expected to bring structure to that, not wait for it

1\. Financial Strategy \& Business Partnering **Own annual budgeting, financial planning, and multi\-year forecasting across divisions (and across entities, if scope extends to sister ventures)**  Build the financial case for new business lines, tenders, and pricing decisions: model margins on project bids before they're submitted, not after **Act as thought partner to the founder/CEO on capital allocation, hiring plans, and investment decisions**  Own cash flow strategy and working capital management across long\-cycle government/institutional payment timelines **Prepare board\-/founder\-level financial narratives, not just numbers, but what they mean and what to do about them 2\. Finance \& Accounting Oversight**  Own the finance function end\-to\-end: AP, AR, general ledger, monthly and annual close, reviewed and signed off by you **Own preparation and integrity of financial statements (P\&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) and present these to leadership**  Set and enforce financial controls, approval hierarchies, and delegation of authority across the org **Manage relationships with auditors, tax advisors, and legal counsel; own the audit process end\-to\-end, not just coordinate it 3\.
